body: I felt my heart race as I noticed a faint ink trace beneath his desk, just above the crumpled piece of paper he had scribbled on earlier in our shared workspace. My curiosity piqued, I leaned forward, reaching out tentatively to brush away the dust particles covering the message. As the paper slipped into my hands, a chill ran down my spine when I realized who this note was from – my best friend, Sarah. She’s always been so distant lately, and now she’s telling me something important.
